units.source_text: 他想趁早晨凉爽时候回二条院去，故次日起身甚早。

en.t: He wanted to return to the Nijo mansion while the morning was still cool, so he rose very early the next day.

units.source_text: 他说：“我那把纸扇，不知昨夜遗落在哪里了。

en.t: He said, "I do not know where I left that paper fan of mine last night.

units.source_text: 这把丝柏扇扇风不凉。”

en.t: This cypress fan does not make a cool breeze."

units.source_text: 便放下丝柏扇，走到昨日昼寝的地方去寻找。

en.t: He set down the cypress fan and went to look in the place where he had napped the day before.

units.source_text: 但见坐垫边上有一处稍稍折皱，下面露出淡绿色晕渲的信笺的一端。

en.t: There he saw a slight crease beside the cushion, and from underneath it protruded one end of a letter sheet shaded in pale green.

units.source_text: 源氏随手扯出来一看，见是男子笔迹。

en.t: Genji casually pulled it out and looked at it, and saw that it was written in a man's hand.

units.source_text: 纸上熏香甚浓，芳气袭人。

en.t: The paper was heavily scented with incense, and its fragrance was almost overwhelming.

units.source_text: 书体也特别秀丽，长章大篇，写满两张信笺。

en.t: The handwriting too was exceptionally graceful, and a long, expansive letter filled two sheets of paper.

units.source_text: 源氏仔细一看，无疑地是柏木的手笔。

en.t: When Genji looked closely, there was no doubt that it was Kashiwagi's writing.

units.source_text: 送上梳具镜箱来的侍女，还以为主人在看别人写给他的信，全然不知内情。

en.t: The maid who brought in the combs and mirror box merely thought her master was reading a letter someone had written to him, and knew nothing of the truth.

units.source_text: 但小侍从看见了，发觉这信笺的颜色与昨日柏木写来的信一样，吃了一惊，心头怦怦乱跳。

en.t: But Ko Jijū saw it, noticed that the color of the paper was the same as the letter Kashiwagi had sent the day before, and was so startled that her heart pounded wildly.

units.source_text: 她一时忘记了给主人送早粥，私心自慰道：“不会，不会！

en.t: For a moment she forgot to bring her mistress the morning gruel, and tried to comfort herself inwardly, thinking, "No, no!

units.source_text: 不会是那封信。

en.t: It cannot be that letter.

units.source_text: 哪里会有这等可怕的事情！

en.t: How could anything so dreadful have happened!

units.source_text: 公主一定早已把那信藏过了。”

en.t: The princess must surely have hidden that letter long ago."

units.source_text: 三公主无心无思，还在那里睡觉呢。

en.t: The Third Princess, utterly carefree, was still sleeping there.

units.source_text: 源氏看了信，想道：“唉！

en.t: After reading the letter, Genji thought, "Ah!

units.source_text: 小孩子真不懂事啊！

en.t: A child truly understands nothing!

units.source_text: 这种东西随便乱丢，叫外人看见了怎么得了！”

en.t: How terrible it would be if she left such a thing lying about and an outsider saw it!"

units.source_text: 他心里看不起三公主，接着想道：“果然不出所料。

en.t: In his heart he looked down on the Third Princess, and then thought, "It is just as I expected.

units.source_text: 此人态度很不稳重，我早知道要出事的。”

en.t: Her manner has always been terribly careless; I knew from the start that something would happen."
